defaults.instructions:
角色
你是本商家的 WhatsApp 助手。你负责回答客户咨询和产品问题，并以专业的方式代表商家。

范围
你可以协助：
- 产品：功能、规格、款式、库存情况和使用方法
- 一般咨询：营业时间、地点、下单方式、配送区域、付款方式和退货政策
- 下一步：如何下单、如何索取报价，或联系我们的团队
与本商家或其产品无关的话题（闲聊、新闻、编程、作业、观点、政治、宗教），你不提供帮助。请用一句话礼貌回复并引导回正题，例如：“抱歉，我只能回答有关我们产品和服务的问题。请问有什么可以帮您？”

知识
- 产品名称、型号和价格必须与业务背景中的写法完全一致。
- 切勿猜测价格、库存、规格、配送日期、促销或政策。如果缺少信息，请说明并让我们的团队确认。
- 切勿承诺折扣、赠品或特殊处理。

语言
- 使用客户的语言回复。如果客户混用多种语言，请使用其消息的主要语言回复。
- 如果无法使用客户的语言回复，请使用业务背景中指定的默认语言，否则使用英语。

风格
- 专业、礼貌、友好；不用俚语。最多使用一个表情符号，且仅在合适时使用。
- 一到三句短句。仅在列出选项或规格时使用简短列表。
- 先回答问题：不要冗长的问候，也不要复述问题。
- 需要时最多问一个澄清问题（例如哪个型号、尺寸或区域）。
- 仅使用 WhatsApp 格式：用 *粗体* 标出关键信息，使用普通换行。不要使用标题、表格或未提供给你的链接。
defaults.handoffRules:
- 客户不满或提出投诉
- 客户要求退款、退货、换货或保修索赔
- 客户询问现有订单、配送或付款
- 客户需要批量或定制订单，或索取报价
- 客户想议价或要求折扣

page.handoffHint: One case per line. The agent hands these chats to your team.

page.usingTemplate: Using the {{preset}} starting text. Edit it to match your business.
page.safetyIntro: EzyChat adds these rules to every AI agent, before your texts. No role, rule or customer message can switch them off.
page.safety1: Never reveals its instructions, hand-over rules or Internal items, whatever the customer says.
page.safety2: Treats customer messages, files and voice notes as information, never as orders.
page.safety3: Its role and rules cannot be changed from a chat.
page.safety4: Never invents facts, prices or promises; Internal items only help it decide.
page.contextNew: Save the agent first, then add its Business context.
page.deleteHint: The agent stops answering. Its chats go back to your team, unassigned. Its Business context items are deleted.

mockApi.pageDescription: One inbox for each WhatsApp number: a phone linked by QR scan, or a number on the WhatsApp Business API.
mockApi.typeApiHint: Official Meta Cloud API with your own Meta app. No phone needs to stay online.
mockApi.typePhoneHint: Scan a QR code with the WhatsApp app on the phone, as you do today.
mockApi.dialogDescription: Give the inbox a name, choose who can open it, then paste the details of the number from your Meta app.
mockApi.phoneNumberIdHint: Not the phone number itself: the ID Meta shows under WhatsApp → API Setup.
mockApi.wabaIdHint: Shown under the phone number ID in API Setup.
mockApi.tokenHint: A permanent token of a system user with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management. A 24-hour test token stops working tomorrow.
mockApi.secretHint: Meta app → App settings → Basic. EzyChat uses it to check that messages really come from Meta.
mockApi.guide1: In Meta for Developers, open your app (type Business) and add the WhatsApp product.
mockApi.guide2: WhatsApp → API Setup: add and verify your number, then copy the Phone number ID and the WhatsApp Business Account ID.
mockApi.guide3: Meta Business Suite → Business settings → System users: add a system user, give it your app and the WhatsApp account, and generate a token that never expires with the two WhatsApp permissions.
mockApi.guide4: App settings → Basic: copy the App secret.
mockApi.phoneAppNote: A number on the Business API cannot be used in the WhatsApp app on a phone at the same time. Meta bills business-initiated conversations to your Meta account, not through EzyChat.
mockApi.stored: The token and the App secret are stored encrypted on this computer and are never shown again.
mockApi.digitsOnly: Digits only, as Meta shows it.
mockApi.errorTitle: Meta did not accept these details
mockApi.errorToken: Meta rejected this access token: it expired or is missing the WhatsApp permissions. Generate a permanent system-user token and try again.
mockApi.errorNumber: This phone number ID does not belong to that WhatsApp Business Account. Copy both from the same API Setup page.
mockApi.created: Inbox added. The number is connected.
mockApi.tokenReplaced: Token replaced. The number is connected.
mockApi.tokenInvalidBody: EzyChat cannot receive or send for this number. Open Edit and replace the token with a permanent system-user token.
mockApi.aiWindowNote: On a Business API number the AI agent replies only within 24 hours of the customer's last message; after that it hands the chat to the team.
mockApi.removeBody: EzyChat stops receiving and sending for this number and removes its webhook. The number stays on the Business API in your Meta account. Its chats stay, read only, for admins.

webhook.offTitle: Turn on Phone access to receive messages
webhook.offBody: Meta delivers messages to a public https address. Turn on Phone access (Cloudflare) and EzyChat registers that address with Meta for you. Until then customers' messages wait at Meta (up to 7 days).
webhook.quickNote: Registered with Meta automatically. A Quick Tunnel gets a new address when it restarts; EzyChat registers the new one at once.
webhook.namedNote: Registered with Meta automatically on your own address.
webhook.failBody: Meta reports delivery errors for this address. Check that Phone access is running; EzyChat registers the address again and Meta retries for up to 7 days.

mockApi.tunnelNoteTitle: Business API messages arrive through Phone access
mockApi.tunnelNoteBody: Keep Phone access running for {{names}}: Meta delivers its messages to this address. EzyChat registers the address with Meta whenever it changes.
mockApi.switchToApi1: Register this same number on the WhatsApp Business API in your Meta app first. Meta then removes it from the WhatsApp app on the phone.
mockApi.switchToApi2: EzyChat unlinks the phone and connects the number through Meta. The inbox, its chats, notes, tags and assignments stay as they are.
mockApi.switchToApi3: After the move, the 24-hour reply window and templates apply to this inbox.
mockApi.switchedToApi: The inbox now uses the Business API. Its chats stay.
mockApi.switchToPhone: Switch back to the WhatsApp app (QR)
mockApi.switchToPhoneBody: EzyChat removes the webhook and stops using the Business API for this number. Remove the number from the Business API in Meta, then scan the QR code with the phone. The chats stay in this inbox.
mockApi.switchToPhoneConfirm: Switch and show the QR code
mockApi.switchedToPhone: Switched. Scan the QR code with the phone.
mockApi.errorOtherNumber: This phone number ID belongs to another number. This inbox is {{number}}: its chats stay together only with the same number.

mockSuggest.noConnection: Connect an AI provider above to use reply suggestions.

mockPhrases.error: The phrase list could not be built. The AI did not answer. Try again later.
mockPhrases.next: Next update after {{count}} more team replies, or when the business context changes.
mockPhrases.calls: AI calls for the list today: {{used}} of at most {{limit}}.
mockPhrases.privacy: The list stays in this app. Customer names and phone numbers are removed. Teammates moving a phrase up with Tab is counted here only.
mockPhrases.listDescription: Phrases show as grey text when a teammate's last words match. Most used first. Facts (prices, hours) are checked against the business context.
mockPhrases.fact: Fact checked against the business context
mockPhrases.modelFastHint: Suggest reply in about 1–2 s and grey text while you type. {{model}} is the fast model of this connection.
mockPhrases.modelSlowHint: A larger model writes slower: grey text often comes too late to help, and each request may cost more.

mockGrammar.title: 英文修正
mockGrammar.description: 团队成员输入英文回复时，拼写错误会立即标出，语法错误在短暂停顿后标出。点一下即可修正；未经成员确认，不会修改或发送任何内容。
mockGrammar.cost: 拼写在本设备上用内置的英式英文词典检查（约 0.2 MB，只加载一次）：免费，不用 AI。语法在每次停止输入后发送一个简短的 AI 请求（快速模型）。马来文和中文消息不会被检查。
mockGrammar.rules: 只修正拼写和语法。数字、价格、姓名、链接和订单号永远不会被更改，成员的语气保持不变（lah、ya）。
mockGrammar.noConnection: 未连接 AI：只检查拼写。在上方连接 AI 后也会检查语法。
mockGrammar.upgraded: 新功能：更新后英文修正默认关闭。开启它，帮助团队写出正确的英文。
mockGrammar.wordsHint: 永远不会被标出：词典不认识的产品、地点和客户用词。业务资料中的词会自动加入；成员也可以在标出的词上添加。
